output.reason: [ev-621f5e4bbeea] says the deprecated `-s3.sse-encryption` config is removed in 3.0.0 in favour of the `-s3.sse.*` settings. The upgrade guide [ev-c8a8a9c16d41] confirms that `s3.sse-encryption` is removed and says to use `sse.type` to set the SSE type. A removed config key means the configured value is no longer honoured, which is setting-ignored. The proposed statement and remediation match the evidence. Neither excerpt says what Loki does at startup if the old flag is still set, so a stronger failure kind is not supported.
